question: According to the World Bank, what was the literacy rate of the total adult population (% of people ages 15 and above) in 2019 in Pakistan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**58%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the World Bank, the literacy rate of the total adult population (% of people ages 15 and above) in 2019 in Pakistan is** 58%.**
 
• The current literacy rate in Pakistan is 62.3 per cent which means that around** 90 million people in the country cannot read and write.**
